queries.query: Masaurhi Bihar official cadastral map land records parcel map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Bihar's official BhuNaksha cadastral viewer and BiharBhumi/Department of Revenue and Land Reforms portals. The viewer's public JavaScript exposed anonymous location-list and map endpoints, but no safe bounded parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: Masaurhi Bihar bhunaksha khasra naksha official
queries.result: The Hindi/local-language discovery route identified the same official Bihar BhuNaksha and BiharBhumi services. No separate local public parcel service or safe parcel geometry response was exposed.

researchNote: Bihar Directorate of Land Records and Survey is evidenced as the state cadastral custodian by the official BhuNaksha viewer. Public location lists identified Patna district (28), Masaurhi subdivision (04), Masaurhi circle (12), and village entries including Chhotki Masaurhi (0744). Anonymous extent requests for candidate villages returned empty bodies; this is an unusable response, not evidence of absence. No parcel geometry was retained.
